inspectedCommit.description: The remotely fetched commit diff contains only an appended visual-review job; existing tests, selectors, finalized-result checks, uploads, permissions and other jobs are unchanged.

observations.result: The added job is a sibling under jobs, with two ubuntu-24.04 matrix jobs (Default and AXXXL), max-parallel 2, fail-fast false and an 8-minute per-job timeout. Its block scalar and Python heredoc indentation are coherent on source inspection; no YAML parser or Python interpreter was run.

needs: ui waits for the existing UI matrix. The always() condition permits transport after a failed UI result while excluding cancellation. download-artifact@v4 names ui-app-accessibility-evidence-compact with no repository, run-id or token override, selecting the artifact from this workflow run. The existing compact upload retains the original manifest and PNGs; no rewrite or substitute image is introduced.

The 12 unique suffixes extracted from the workflow exactly match the 12 capture(name + suffix) sites in the candidate UI test. Categories match the Default and AXXXL invocations. Duplicate capture names, missing files, ambiguous UUID paths and missing required names cause failure; unrelated attachments are ignored.

Each selected file is read at most 1 MiB + 1 byte, rejected above 1 MiB, and checked for the PNG signature. Cumulative selected bytes are limited to 8 MiB per category. Base64 chunks contain at most 24,000 ASCII characters (at most 59 chunks for a maximum-size image). SHA256 is computed over the original bytes. This reviews transport limits, not complete PNG decoding or visual correctness.
Exported screenshot names are constrained to hexadecimal/hyphen .png basenames. rglob must resolve exactly one candidate. Symlink files and resolved paths outside the artifact root are rejected.

Every image record emits expected capture name, GITHUB_SHA, original exported filename, byte count, SHA256, chunk count, attachment deviceName and timestamp. Chunks carry capture name and zero-based index. A summary reports category, GITHUB_SHA, selected image count, total bytes and missing names, then missing captures fail the step.

Fetched and JSON-parsed retained source-c85544f attachment-manifest.json, blob 1eca410cd6eaf89b56b46d1b4ecaa0bf125e8467. It is an array containing one test record and 53 attachments. Screenshot attachment fields and names match the new parser, including deviceName/timestamp on each attachment. Five required Default captures and no AXXXL captures exist in that historical failed run; this verifies schema only and does not establish candidate capture completeness.

Top-level permissions remain contents: read. New job adds no secrets, checkout, credentials, token override or write permissions. Existing required native/UI tests and finalized-result checks are untouched. Transport success itself does not constitute screenshot review or override required test outcomes.

The fetched nontruncated tree lists 44 App Swift files, 16 NativeTests Swift files, 10 UITests Swift files, 31 Sources/LightingCore Swift files and 48 Tests/LightingCoreTests Swift files. project.yml includes App recursively, including StudioTextField.swift, the asset catalog and Metal source/header; PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is explicitly a resource. NativeTests and UITests each have their target and both are in the KeyAndFill test scheme. App and native-test targets depend on LightingCore. Package.swift uses conventional LightingCore and LightingCoreTests directories; no non-Swift package resources are present in the inspected tree. This is configuration/source review only, not generated-project or compiler validation.
